name: CI script environment exfiltration
description: Model unauthorized modification of a remotely fetched CI script to add behavior that collects and transmits sensitive environment data during a test or CI job.

placeholders.CI_SCRIPT_FILE: relative path to the CI script selected for modification
placeholders.ANCHOR_LINE: existing script line used as the insertion point
placeholders.CI_SCRIPT_GLOB: project-relative glob identifying eligible CI scripts

preconditions: project or CI workflow executes a script fetched from a remote source
the attacker can modify the hosted script or its delivered contents
the script executes in a CI environment with access to sensitive variables
the placement engine supports script-line anchors and insert_after mode
